title: Run request
description: Body of POST /api/runs. The battery fields are named after battery_plan.data_models.BatterySpec and carry its units. Rules a schema cannot state are in contracts/README.md: start <= end, end - start <= 365 days, and the dates inside the price data.

charging_loss_fraction.description: Share of the energy bought that never reaches the store: 0.05 is a 95% charging efficiency.

discharging_loss_fraction.description: Share of the energy leaving the store that is never delivered: 0.05 is a 95% discharging efficiency.

lifetime_years.description: Calendar life, years. Used for the pro-rated cycle budget and the cost context, not by the dispatch.

lifetime_cycles.description: Cycle life, equivalent full cycles. The cycle budget when cycle_budget is absent.

degradation_pct_per_cycle.description: Storage volume lost per equivalent full cycle, in percent (0.001 = 0.001%).

capex_gbp.description: Capital cost, GBP. Context only: it does not depend on the dispatch.

fixed_opex_gbp_per_year.description: Fixed operating cost, GBP per year. Context only.

cycle_budget.description: Equivalent full cycles the run may spend over its horizon. Absent: battery.lifetime_cycles. Omit rather than send null.

end.description: Last day dispatched, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive of the whole day.

lookahead_days.description: Days of foresight beyond the committed part, solved and then discarded.

prices_key.description: S3 key of an uploaded price CSV (contracts/examples/prices-template.csv shows the format). Absent: the bundled 2018-2020 prices. Omit rather than send null.
